notes: Dashboard created on 2026-05-13 as part of Phase 3 SP5.
All 6 blocks created successfully via lark-cli base +dashboard-block-create.

SCHEMA DRIFT: 'timeline' block type is NOT supported by lark-cli. Available types: column|bar|line|pie|ring|area|combo|scatter|funnel|wordCloud|radar|statistics|text. Block 4 uses 'column' as substitute.
SCHEMA DRIFT: data_config uses 'table_name' (string, display name), NOT 'table_id'. This is critical.
SCHEMA DRIFT: 'series' and 'count_all' are mutually exclusive. Statistics cards either count records OR aggregate a numeric field.
SCHEMA DRIFT: T02 has no datetime field at top level; 'by date' grouping substituted with trigger_type select field.
T01 status field is named 'task_status' (not 'status') with options: completed|in_progress|blocked|pending|active.
T16 extracted_concept_count is type 'number'; filter uses isGreater operator with numeric value.
